_comment: A real committed Realio mainnet tx (one MsgBridgeOut from a third-party account, height 20230800), captured 2026-10-23 from realio-rpc.noders.services (CometBFT 0.38.19) for the pollTx tests (WO-084). `tx_b64` is data.txs[0] of /block?height=20230800; `result` is txs_results[0] of /block_results?height=20230800 minus `data` and `events` (which no test reads). txs_results[i].code is present as the integer 0 (not omitted), so an absent code is no answer (D3). Nothing here is signed or secret.
